chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad ibn Usman, from Al-Halby, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who kills the bug, the flea, the louse, and the fly during the prayer: Does it break his prayer and his ablution? He said: No.
ai.seo_question: Does killing insects during prayer invalidate the prayer or ablution?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that killing small insects like bugs, fleas, lice, and flies during prayer does not invalidate the prayer (*salah*) nor break the ablution (*wudu*). This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly consensus that minor distractions or actions involving small creatures do not constitute a nullifier of prayer, distinguishing them from major acts of invalidation. The narration underscores the practical ease (*yusr*) in Shia jurisprudence regarding daily occurrences during worship.
